pmid:41398009.reason: Statins reduce UBL3-dependent PD-L1 sorting to sEVs in vitro with a small patient serum comparison; mechanistic, limited clinical data.

pmid:41390939.reason: Retrospective VHA cohort of 3739 stage IV NSCLC patients on ICI vs 6585 on chemotherapy used propensity-weighted Cox models and a chemotherapy negative-control cohort; 14 of 20 medication classes (including antihistamines, NSAIDs, statins, metformin as assessed) showed no association with OS or time-to-next-treatment and the associations seen were non-specific, suggesting prior reports reflect unmeasured confounding; limitation is retrospective claims-type data with residual confounding.

pmid:41271670.reason: Fosinopril (ACE inhibitor) inhibited NSCLC cell growth and xenograft tumours via GSDME pyroptosis; in vivo only, no clinical data.

pmid:41232243.reason: Inhalable exosome-camouflaged disulfiram nanocarrier extended survival in a lung cancer animal model; formulation-focused, in vivo only.

pmid:41195639.reason: Single-centre retrospective study (124 NSCLC pts on first-line ICI): baseline PPI worse PFS, low-dose aspirin longer PFS (HR 0.31); small, multivariate but confounded.

pmid:41194930.reason: Multicentre retrospective study of 462 advanced lung cancer patients on ICIs (318 after propensity matching); beta-blocker use was associated with longer PFS (15.8 vs 11.8 months, HR 0.67) and higher ORR (51.1% vs 35.2%) but not OS (HR 1.38, NS); limitations are retrospective design, only 88 beta-blocker users, possible confounding by indication and cardiovascular comorbidity.

pmid:41188518.reason: Retrospective single-centre cohort (417 NSCLC with brain metastases): platelet inhibitors linked to later neurosurgery (63 vs 47 months) and longer OS (12 vs 10 months); confounding by indication likely.

pmid:41163198.reason: Meta-analysis of statins during radiotherapy across cancers (21 studies); NSCLC subgroup showed reduced survival and higher MACE; mixed cancer types, mostly cohort data.

pmid:41147148.reason: Oral SAS + DSF in Nano-SEDDS suppressed NNK-induced lung tumours in mice at lower doses; in vivo only.

pmid:41122174.reason: Retrospective three-hospital cohort (n=235) of statin use with ICIs in lung cancer: better OS/PFS in users, plus RORA bioinformatics; small, confounding likely.

pmid:41083699.reason: TriNetX PS-matched cohort (158,224 T2DM pts): GLP-1 RA vs DPP4i lung cancer HR 0.86; incidence outcome, retrospective, residual confounding.

pmid:41024580.reason: Clarithromycin prevented premalignant/malignant lung lesions in KrasG12D mice with immune/microbiome effects; in vivo only.

pmid:41011257.reason: Meta-analysis of metformin with radiotherapy (25 studies, all cancers); no significant overall survival difference, conflicting NSCLC trends.

pmid:40999304.reason: Metformin reduced lysosomal trapping of CDK4/6 inhibitors in NSCLC cells and enhanced effect in xenografts/organoids; preclinical only.

pmid:40985476.reason: Preclinical study showing ouabain and digoxin (cardiac glycosides) combined with anti-CD47 antibody reduced tumour volume in several lung cancer in vivo models and increased macrophage phagocytosis about 5-fold via calreticulin translocation; authors state clinical translation is supported; limitation is mouse and cell models only, no human data.

pmid:40835442.reason: Auranofin sensitised SCLC cells to sorafenib and inhibited SCLC xenograft growth; preclinical in vivo only.

pmid:40799435.reason: In vivo nude-mouse A549 xenograft study of fenbendazole (anthelmintic) plus diisopropylamine dichloroacetate: the combination gave greater tumour regression and complete tumour loss than either single agent over 60 days, with a stated call for a clinical study; limitation is small immunodeficient xenograft model, no human data.

pmid:40743913.reason: Retrospective Military Health System cohort of 5096 NSCLC patients (864 post-diagnosis statin users) using time-dependent Cox models (addresses immortal-time bias); each additional year of statin use gave adjusted HR 0.82 (0.75-0.90) for overall survival; limitations are observational design, residual confounding by indication/healthy-user effect and a largely military-beneficiary population.

pmid:40737255.reason: Retrospective single-centre study (130 LUAD with T2DM): metformin users had smaller tumours and no nodal metastasis; pathological features only, no survival.

pmid:40731791.reason: Retrospective study of 152 metastatic NSCLC on nivolumab: metformin users had longer OS but more grade 3-4 thrombocytopenia; small, single-centre, imbalanced groups.

pmid:40721007.reason: Dihydroartemisinin suppressed NSCLC via MDM2/c-Myc in cells and in vivo xenografts; preclinical only.

pmid:40647360.reason: Retrospective study of 650 NSCLC pts: antiplatelet (mostly aspirin) users had fewer brain metastases (6.9% vs 20.0%); confounding by indication and immortal-time risk.

pmid:40617617.reason: Meta-analysis of 25 mostly observational studies (51,536 NSCLC pts): statin use associated with improved OS (HR 0.77); heterogeneity and confounding.

pmid:40613783.reason: GGPS1 as a chemoresistance biomarker in 146 SCLC cases; statin plus chemotherapy improved response in a PDX model; biomarker-focused.

pmid:40548761.reason: SEER-Medicare retrospective cohort of 1123 metformin vs 362 sulfonylurea/DPP-4 users with NSCLC starting ICI, with stabilised IPTW and competing-risk models; no significant difference in cancer-specific or all-cause mortality (adjusted rate difference about 1 and 4 per 100 person-years); null result with active-comparator design, limited by claims data, older patients and residual confounding.

pmid:40534194.reason: S- and R-carvedilol both reduced benzo(a)pyrene-induced lung tumours in mice, independent of beta-blockade; preclinical only.

pmid:40532471.reason: Post hoc analysis of nationwide French retrospective cohort IFCT-1502 CLINIVO (753 advanced NSCLC patients on nivolumab) adjusting for comorbidity and disease aggressiveness; metformin was associated with better overall survival while morphine and high-dose corticosteroids were associated with worse OS and PFS; limitations are retrospective design, second-line-plus nivolumab only and residual confounding.

pmid:40398400.reason: Propensity-matched TriNetX cohort of 4379 lung cancer patients on ICIs (from 16,650) found statin use associated with lower 12-month MACE (HR 0.87) and lower all-cause mortality (HR 0.83) without increased serious irAEs; primary outcome is cardiovascular rather than tumour response, and database design carries confounding by indication and coding limitations.

pmid:40371164.reason: Disulfiram identified by drug screen as a sensitiser of cisplatin in SCLC cells via CBS/H2S inhibition, with significant tumour reduction in nude-mouse SCLC xenografts for the combination; authors call for immediate clinical assessment; limitation is cell lines and xenograft only.

pmid:40361517.reason: TriNetX PS-matched GLP-1 RA study in neuroendocrine neoplasms (HR 0.56); lung NENs HR 0.42 but not lung-cancer-specific, retrospective.

pmid:40159404.reason: Single-hospital registry cohort of 1886 stage IV lung cancer patients (594 post-diagnosis antihistamine users); post-diagnosis users surviving more than 90 days had median OS 28.4 vs 15.1 months (HR 0.49), pre-diagnosis use showed no benefit; the 90-day landmark partly addresses immortal-time bias but confounding by indication, single-centre data and a very large effect size warrant caution.

pmid:40130115.reason: Systematic review of six studies (4171 pts, multiple cancers incl. lung) on antihistamines with ICIs, all reporting better survival; small, observational, no pooled estimate.

pmid:40124597.reason: Albumin-bound fluvastatin nanoformulation (Abstatin) amplified anti-PD-1 efficacy in murine and humanised PDX NSCLC models by lowering hypoxia and lipid-raft integrity, with minimal toxicity; directly relevant to statin plus ICI; limitation is preclinical only and a novel formulation rather than the approved drug.

pmid:40114952.reason: Aspirin upregulated GPIHBP1 in NSCLC (10 vs 10 patients) with xenograft support; small mechanistic study.

pmid:39929787.reason: Retrospective single-hospital study of 300 metastatic NSCLC: ACEi/ARB users had higher 36- and 60-month survival; unadjusted/confounded.

pmid:39886963.reason: Loratadine induced autophagy-mediated apoptosis in LUAD cells and reduced xenograft tumour growth independent of HRH1; preclinical only.

pmid:39818516.reason: SEER-Medicare retrospective cohort of 1401 older NSCLC patients on ICIs; time-updated concurrent statin use was associated with lower lung-cancer-specific (HR 0.59, 0.35-0.99) and overall mortality (HR 0.62), adjusted with a propensity score; wide CIs, limited anti-PD-L1 numbers, observational with residual confounding and claims-based exposure.

pmid:39766358.reason: PLGA-encapsulated disulfiram plus copper was effective in a metastatic NSCLC mouse model and targets cancer stem cells; preclinical.

pmid:39759894.reason: Retrospective study of 34 NSCLC pts with T2DM on immunotherapy: metformin associated with OS (HR 0.31) but not ORR/PFS; very small sample.

nct:NCT07303816.reason: Phase 4 placebo-controlled trial (n=4000) of rosuvastatin to prevent cancer-associated VTE; repurposed statin RCT but pan-cancer and VTE endpoint, not tumour outcome.
